summary:
StellarLens transforms the way people explore the universe by turning complex astronomical observations into an immersive, interactive 3D experience. Inspired by NASA's SPHERE mission, which maps the entire sky across 102 near-infrared spectral bands, StellarLens aims to make the hidden layers of the cosmos accessible to everyone.
Through an intuitive web-based platform, users can explore celestial objects, navigate a 3D representation of the sky, and experience visual simulations of infrared observations and spectral variations. The project addresses a key challenge: making massive and complex astronomical datasets easier to understand, explore, and compare over time.
By bridging scientific visualization with public engagement, StellarLens opens a new window into space exploration, empowering students, educators, and astronomy enthusiasts to discover the universe beyond what the human eye can see. Its long-term vision is to support the exploration of real SPHEREx observations and encourage
collaborative discovery through citizen science.
details:
StellarLens is an interactive, browser-based astronomical visualization platform inspired by NASA's SPHEREX mission and its survey of the entire sky across 102 near-infrared spectral bands.

The project addresses the challenge of making large and complex astronomical observations accessible to the public. While SPHERE produces an enormous amount of scientific data, exploring and understanding these observations can be difficult for people without specialized astronomical software or technical expertise.

StellarLens approaches this problem through an intuitive 3D sky exploration experience. Users can navigate a vis representation of the celestial sphere, explore selected astronomical objects, and interact with visual simulation inspired by infrared spectral observations. The current platform is a developing prototype that combines conceptual visualizations with selected project features, rather than claiming complete integration of the official SPHEREx scientific archive.

The platform is developed using JavaScript, Three.js, WebGL, GLL shaders, and CSS3, with a focus on interactive graphics and accessible web technologies.

Its creativity lies in transforming complex scientific concepts into an engaging visual experience that encourages curiosity and makes astronomy more approachable, Its intended impact is to support science education, inspire young explorers, and create a foundation for future integration of authentic SPHEREx datasets, time-based comparisons, and citizen science contributions.

StellarLens is designed to grow from an educational visualization prototype into a more comprehensive public gateway to infrared astronomy.
